messages.subject: Bioc-teaching call March 11, 3-4pm CET
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

a quick reminder of the bioconductor-teaching group call on Monday, March 11, 3-4pm CET. US (and perhaps also other) participants - please take note that Europe has not yet changed to summer time, so this month's meeting will be at a different time than usual for you.

Jitsi link: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you on Monday,
Charlotte & Laurent
